scope_notice: AST inventory enumerates functions but is not execution or security coverage. Only named current review families were inspected; other files retain historical source-scoped evidence and remain outside this workstream current detailed review. No whole-project security guarantee follows.

finding.problem: exists() classified a dangling entry or suppressed filesystem access error as absence, allowing generic configuration/dry-run journal fresh defaults. Existing live keeper state/runtime and nonce admission already prevent a demonstrated signing bypass.
finding.fix: lstat admits only FileNotFoundError as absence; present targets must parse and other filesystem failures propagate. Valid readable generic config links remain compatible; live symlink restrictions unchanged.
finding.tests: 3 new baseline regressions reproduced; 5 new methods pass after fix; 2 real-symlink methods explicitly skipped on Windows privilege1314. No unchanged methods rerun.

accepted_or_unqualified_boundaries: Read-only RPC/header trust and operator-maintained log completeness are not cryptographic completeness proofs.
Exact-unit lifetime history and immutable checkpoints retain bounded workloads; archival/checkpoint operating qualification remains open.
Full keeper requires reviewed Linux/systemd/locking/keystore setup and actual outage/recovery operation; none started here.
Manual B/C/D emits gas separately from calldata as documented; future inclusion/provider/gas acceptance remains open.
Manual preparers support empty-code governance EOAs only; Safe/delegated EOA envelopes require separate reviewed preparation.
Ordinary keeper compounding threshold policy is service-enforced in addition to independent on-chain guards; it is not immutable enforcement of all service behavior.
Real independent feeds/routes/depth/VRF/OpenSea, complete target fees, maximum state and independent audit remain release gates.
Historical compatibility modules/readers are not obsolete merely because current fresh configuration excludes their profile.
